textos.Espectadores consideram que o filme é lo: Viewers consider the film too long for the story it tells, with more than three hours that could be cut without loss, making the experience tiring.
textos.O ritmo é descrito como arrastado, com m: The pace is described as drawn out, with moments of boredom and a feeling that the narrative is slow to get going, leading some to doze off or give up.
textos.As atuações são criticadas por serem tea: The performances are criticized as theatrical and exaggerated, with very intense emotions and mannerisms that feel false or dated.
textos.Espectadores acham os personagens rasos: Viewers find the characters shallow and forgettable, with little development, apart from one or two who stand out.
textos.A história é vista como simples demais p: The story is seen as too simple to justify the long running time, with irrelevant subplots and a development that does not hold attention.
textos.Espectadores questionam a alta nota e o: Viewers question the high rating and the classic status, considering the film overrated and lacking the merits attributed to it.
textos.Reviews medianas reclamam que o filme é: Middling reviews complain that the film is very long, with a running time that could be cut without loss, and that the drawn-out pace makes the experience tiring.
textos.Pessoas destacam a beleza das imagens, a: People highlight the beauty of the images, the quality of the cinematography and the camera work, with framing that resembles photographs.
textos.Reviews criticam o estilo de atuação tea: Reviews criticize the theatrical, overly dramatic acting style, with shouting and crying that sound exaggerated to today's viewer.
textos.Roteiro simples e falta de conexão emoci: Simple script and lack of emotional connection
textos.Certos textos apontam que a história é b: Some texts point out that the story is basic and fails to engage, lacking an emotional bond with the characters or the plot.
textos.Mesmo sem grande entusiasmo, reviews adm: Even without great enthusiasm, reviews admit that the film is a pioneer and exerted strong influence on later works, being a landmark of cinema.
textos.Expectativa versus realidade e sensação: Expectation versus reality and a sense of being overrated
textos.Pessoas comentam que criaram expectativa: People comment that they built high expectations because of its fame but were disappointed, feeling the film does not live up to the prestige it receives.
textos.Reviews positivas comentam que, apesar d: Positive reviews comment that, despite the three and a half hours, the film holds attention most of the time, although reviews think it could be leaner.
textos.Este grupo elogia a construção dos perso: This group praises the construction of the characters, with emphasis on Toshirō Mifune's performance and the distinct personality of each samurai.
textos.As reviews positivas exaltam os enquadra: The positive reviews extol the framing, the lighting and the use of rain and mud to create atmosphere, even in black and white.
textos.A direção de Kurosawa é citada como magi: Kurosawa's direction is cited as masterful, with praise for his skill in handling action scenes and developing the script.
textos.As sequências de luta, especialmente a b: The fight sequences, especially the final battle, are described as intense and realistic, contributing to the film's impact.
textos.Reviews destacam que o filme permanece i: Reviews highlight that the film remains impressive and influential decades after its release, inspiring later works.
